lesson_text: STR_1560 Gross Margin Quality (Q10_Gross_Margin 단독): MDD 51.0% hard fail. SR 0.503, CAGR 12.4%. Novy-Marx (2013) gross profitability premium is academically robust but Korean market single-factor exposure cannot avoid crisis drawdowns. OOS retention 0.94 is solid. Alpha trend strongly improving (recent 3Y SR 1.195 vs full 0.503, ratio 2.38). Very low turnover at 44% is an implementability advantage. PIT fully clean (C15 compliant via load_month_factors). Signal has value as diversifier in multi-factor S5 combination with DD brake, not as standalone.
core_reference: Novy-Marx (2013) 'The other side of value: The gross profitability premium'; Factor DB Q10_Gross_Margin
